Maximum capacity (Emax)6 kg up to and including 90 kg

Accuracy ClassC

Maximum number of load cell intervals (n)3000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval Y = Emax / vmin15000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return Z = Emax / (2 * DR)4000
Input impedance400 Ω ± 100 Ω
